7. Known Limitations & E8.5 Readiness

  • RUNTIME_CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUIRED (for E8.5): Unity E8Contract.cs and E8InteractionHud.cs hardcode prompt text by scene ID and ignore Studio interaction label/linkedEntityId in scene.json. Studio preserves those fields in studio-scene-sidecar.json; dynamic prompt binding in Unity should be scheduled cleanly under E8.5 if desired.
  • E7.6R B2 Granularity: Raw E7.6R packages bundle foreground entities into a single foreground-<light>.png without standalone per-entity textures; full per-layer visibility/re-export edits require the E8 runtime bundle format.
  • Single-Landmark Assumption in E8 Runtime: Unity E8SceneData expects a single primary landmark object per scene JSON; Studio maintains an extensible interactions[] array in its internal & sidecar schema.
  • E8.5 Readiness: Studio Native Scene Adapter technical pipeline is ready for Owner Studio Review; E8.5 remains NOT YET AUTHORIZED pending Owner review of E8.4.
